meta.name: clickhouse-js-node-troubleshooting
meta.description: Troubleshoot and resolve common issues with the ClickHouse Node.js client (@clickhouse/client). Use this skill whenever a user reports errors, unexpected behavior, or configuration questions involving the Node.js client specifically — including socket hang-up errors, Keep-Alive problems, stream handling issues, data type mismatches, read-only user restrictions, proxy/TLS setup problems, or long-running query timeouts. Trigger even when the user hasn't precisely named the issue; vague symptoms like "my inserts keep failing" or "connection drops randomly" in a Node.js context are strong signals to use this skill. Do NOT use for browser/Web client issues.

howto.what: 当你在 Node.js 中使用 ClickHouse 客户端时，Claude 会为你排查常见问题并给出解决方案，比如连接断开、数据类型错误、只读用户限制等。
howto.when: 当你报告与 Node.js 客户端相关的错误、异常行为或配置问题，包括 socket hang-up、Keep-Alive 问题、流处理问题等，甚至会处理模糊症状如“插入失败”或“连接随机断开”。此技能不用于浏览器/Web 客户端问题。
